### Slow to Anger: The Beauty of God’s Perfect Patience
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/slow-to-anger
Passage: Exodus 34:6
Points:
- Believers often falter by projecting their own quick-tempered nature onto God.
- At Mount Sinai, God revealed His character as remarkably patient and abounding in steadfast love.
- God's patience is actively shown in history by restraining wrath to allow room for repentance.
- Christ embodied this divine patience supremely through His earthly ministry and sacrificial death.
- God's enduring forbearance serves as an open door calling believers back into fellowship with Him.

### Abounding in Love, Punishing Sin: Resolving Exodus 34
Author: Randy Newman
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/resolving-exodus-34/
Passage: Exodus 34:6-7
Points:
- The text presents a profound tension between God's lavish mercy and His uncompromising justice.
- Humans inherently reflect this tension by longing for unconditional love while demanding that wrongdoing be punished.
- The cross of Christ resolves the paradox by satisfying divine justice while extending full pardon.
- Understanding this balance helps believers explain the necessity of atonement in evangelism.
- While Moses only caught a glimpse of this glory, Christians see it fulfilled in Jesus.
